$comment: The release manifest. A running nudo fetches this to tell you when there is
a newer version, and renders `notes` as the in-app changelog.
Publishing a release is a commit to this file — no CDN, no bespoke service.
The workflow in .github/workflows/release.yml adds an entry on tag push.
Set `breaking` when a release needs manual steps; the dashboard shows those
differently, because the whole point of a changelog is that someone reads the
